facts.fact: 浴室里 Perla 重申家规：Inés 必须伺候她到死、此生别想嫁人；夸 Bartolo 一句都被定性为不检点。
facts.anchor: You must take care of me until I pass away. There’ll be no wedding for you, not now.

facts.fact: Perla 用「外面全是狼」恐吓侄女，并拿亡妹当反面教材；这是她拒绝让 Inés 婚恋的意识形态。
facts.anchor: There are wolves out there, Inés, ready to devour you.

facts.fact: Inés 是私生女：出生证明上没有父亲的姓，因为他是有妇之夫；全镇拿这个羞辱她。
facts.anchor: On her birth certificate her mother had written Inés Inclán, her father’s surname pointedly missing because he was a married man.

facts.fact: 上午 Perla 拉着 Ulises 去广场「遛人」，向全镇展示这个战利品，故意气 Cándido。
facts.anchor: To parade him, like a trophy won at the fair.

facts.fact: Inés 换床单时从 Ulises 手提箱夹层搜出一叠各具化名的行骗信件，和一本被红笔圈满寂寞芳心广告的《Conmovedor》。
facts.anchor: Several ads had been circled with a red pen.

facts.fact: 其中一封信露骨写着「附上一百比索」——他向多名通信对象要钱的铁证。
facts.anchor: Enclosed are the hundred pesos you requested, my dear.

facts.fact: 深夜 Inés 摸进 Ulises 房间摊牌：「我知道你是个骗子」，并逐个点出他的化名。
facts.anchor: “I know you’re a fraud,” she said.

facts.fact: 她开出条件：五五分账；她要的酬劳是「自由」（原文 Freedom, she thought）——逃离这座宅子的赎金。
facts.anchor: “We split the money down the middle,” she said.

facts.fact: Ulises 反威胁要告发她是「浪货」，她选择大胆：一巴掌打过去，逼他接受合伙。
facts.anchor: She chose boldness and slapped him.

facts.fact: 当夜她梦见母亲死在楼梯脚下、双眼盯着抱布娃娃的自己；醒来后的念头是「我必须离开这里」。
facts.anchor: But then came her mother, dead at the foot of the stairs, with her eyes boring into Inés while the girl clutched her doll between her hands.
